articles.title: Zcash’s 25-second blocks go live on public testnet ahead of schedule
articles.snippet: NU7 cuts the target block time from 75 seconds to 25, giving exchanges, wallets and developers a live rehearsal before a planned November mainnet launch.

articles.title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s gubernatorial run lacks the crypto rhetoric of his presidential bid
articles.snippet: The Ohio Republican candidate holds a stake in a digital asset manager and received donations from many in the industry, but has avoided making crypto a central campaign issue.

articles.title: Russia’s Finance Ministry pays wages in digital rubles for first time
articles.snippet: Work on the introduction of the digital ruble to the budget process is being carried out by the Bank of Russia together with the Ministry of Finance.

articles.title: CFTC Unveils Plan to Bring Crypto Exchanges Under Federal Oversight
articles.snippet: The CFTC is seeking public comment on a framework that would create a new federal license for crypto exchanges, with leverage offers as the trigger for oversight.

articles.title: OpenAI Banned PewDiePie Twice While He Built Ajax, an Uncensored AI That Will Run on Your PC
articles.snippet: The YouTuber says OpenAI suspended his account twice while he trained a small, uncensored model built to run on your own computer.
